summary: A fresh twist on cities: Tokyo, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Moscow and Hong Kong come quickly, while New York (#17), London (#20) and Paris (#11) burn lives and Guangzhou, Shenzhen and Chengdu are the reveal.
reasons: Casual found 6 and spent all 5 lives on New York, London, Paris, Mexico City and Mumbai, each showing its riders a year. The trap is the fun, but it sits at the hard edge of a daily.
Clean matching: system names (tokyo metro, toei, mtr, nyc subway), misspellings (shenzen, dehli, hongkong) and old names (peking, canton, bombay) all work; countries, subway and tube are free.
Deep Blitz: 203 cities carry a figure, so nearly every metro city a casual names scores (23 of 24; Seattle has no metro).
fixes: Tokyo is Tokyo Metro alone (2,496.8 million, #6); the source lists Toei Subway separately (963.9 million), and together Tokyo would be #3. Say so in Tokyo's fact (e.g. "Tokyo Metro alone; Toei adds another 964 million"), so a player who expects Tokyo near the top sees why.
Matcher (city lists): "france" offers Fort-de-France and "spain" offers Port of Spain as "did you mean"; a country name on a cities list should be free, not corrected into a city.
